data.one_liner: Get device RAM and disk storage information on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin to query device memory and disk space metrics, along with streaming system memory pressure events. It retrieves values like total, free, and used RAM/ROM in megabytes for both Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to monitor available RAM or disk space in your Flutter app.
You want to listen to system memory pressure events to clear caches before the app is killed.
avoid_when: You need detailed hardware information beyond RAM and ROM.
Your target platform is neither Android nor iOS.
strengths: Provides both memory and disk space usage metrics.
Includes a memory pressure event stream for handling low-memory warnings.
Values are collected off the main thread.
weaknesses: Some memory and disk fields return null depending on the OS or if run on a simulator.
Android 14+ restricts some trim memory levels, making certain warning events rare.
data.setup_notes: Shipped with an iOS privacy manifest; no special manual setup steps are documented.
